description: List launch platforms, directories, communities, newsletters, press and review sites that take product submissions, highest Ahrefs Domain Rating first. Every filter is optional; combine them to narrow the list.

acceptance.description: everyone: every product that fits. reviewed: most get in. selective: only a few are picked

backlink.description: The link the product gets: dofollow helps SEO

exposure.description: featured_to_audience: shown on their homepage, newsletter or social. depends_on_votes: visibility depends on upvotes. listing_only: a listing page, little promotion

niche.description: Products the site is for. general sites take any product

offset.description: Sites to skip, from next_offset of the previous page

price.description: free: free to list, including sites with paid options. free_without_backlink: free without having to link back to them. paid: paid only

q.description: Part of the site's name or domain, e.g. hunt or betalist

name: search_sites
title: Search sites to submit a product to
